summary.en: A three-stage RLHF pipeline that aligned language-model behavior with written instructions and human preferences
summary.zh: 通过三阶段 RLHF 流程让语言模型行为对齐书面指令与人类偏好

description.en:
InstructGPT addressed a mismatch between next-token prediction and what users actually ask a model to do. OpenAI collected demonstrations and preference comparisons, then used supervised fine-tuning, reward modeling and reinforcement learning to tune GPT-3 models toward helpful instruction following.

Human evaluators preferred the 1.3-billion-parameter InstructGPT model over the 175-billion-parameter GPT-3 baseline on the studied prompt distribution. The result made RLHF a practical recipe for post-training general-purpose language models.
description.zh:
InstructGPT 针对下一个 token 预测目标与用户实际要求之间的错位。OpenAI 收集示范答案和偏好比较，再通过监督微调、奖励模型与强化学习，让 GPT-3 模型更好地遵循有帮助的指令。

在研究使用的提示分布上，人类评估者更偏好 13 亿参数的 InstructGPT，而不是 1,750 亿参数的 GPT-3 基线。这一结果使 RLHF 成为通用语言模型后训练的实用范式。

html.en: Large pretrained models could complete text fluently but did not reliably infer a user's intent. InstructGPT emerged from earlier human-preference research as a direct attempt to align model behavior after pretraining.
html.zh: 大型预训练模型能够流畅续写文本，却不能稳定理解用户意图。InstructGPT 延续早期人类偏好研究，直接尝试在预训练之后对齐模型行为。

html.en: The pipeline first fine-tunes on human demonstrations, then learns a reward model from ranked responses, and finally optimizes the policy with PPO. Keeping these stages separate turns qualitative preference judgments into a trainable signal.
html.zh: 流程先使用人类示范进行监督微调，再从排序后的回答中学习奖励模型，最后用 PPO 优化策略。把这些阶段分开，使定性的偏好判断转化为可训练信号。

html.en: Experts generally treat InstructGPT as the operational template for modern RLHF post-training. Its importance lies less in raw parameter scale than in showing that smaller aligned models can be preferred over much larger untuned baselines.
html.zh: 专家通常把 InstructGPT 视为现代 RLHF 后训练的操作模板。它的重要性不只在参数规模，而在于证明更小的对齐模型也可能比大得多的未调优基线更受用户偏好。
